summary: Maison Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its 91.67% equity interest in Super HK of El Monte, Inc. to DNL Management Inc. for $1.00. The transaction closed simultaneously with the execution of the Equity Purchase Agreement on July 2, 2026, and was approved by the board. The buyer assumed all debts, obligations, and liabilities on an as-is, where-is basis. Economic results are retroactively allocated as of April 30, 2026. This nominal-price divestiture suggests a distressed or liability-transfer exit. Watch for any related party disclosures or subsequent write-offs; the $1 price implies minimal return to Maison.
